description: Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms - The Trusts (Information Relating to Express Trusts) Regulation 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms under the Trusts Ordinance, establishing legal requirements for record-keeping, registration, and information maintenance for express trusts.
